name: What is the difference between commercial and light-commercial repair?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between commercial and light-commercial repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: The distinction between commercial and light-commercial repair often lies in the scale, complexity, and specific nature of the property and project. Commercial repair broadly encompasses all non-residential properties, including large-scale industrial complexes, high-rise offices, and expansive retail centers. Light-commercial repair specifically focuses on smaller commercial spaces such as storefronts, small office buildings, restaurants, and multi-tenant common areas. Light-commercial projects typically involve less extensive structural work, simpler systems, and potentially fewer regulatory hurdles compared to large-scale commercial developments, often allowing for quicker turnaround times.
acceptedAnswer.description: Light-commercial repair focuses on smaller properties like storefronts and offices, while general commercial repair includes larger, more complex non-residential projects.
